_about: Central env list (CONTRACT.md section 7). hipaa = the environment holds HIPAA client records (ruled 10/6/26, Dylan: Recovery ONLY; the rest are fine). Its client-identifying information is never PERSISTED outside Dataverse: job files and the store may not sit in a git-tracked folder. The shared log is a Dataverse table, so it carries names in full; printed output is not redacted (dropped 10/7/26, Dylan). closed_year = the closed-fiscal-year guard (DESIGN.md 8d): table -> book-date column; a gift or soft credit in a closed FY is never created, edited or deactivated (an FY locks Dec 1 after it ends; Dylan 9/24 + 9/29/26). Gifts and soft credits are both msnfp_transaction rows. publisher = the id of the SBRM publisher (prefix sbrm) that owns SBRM's own solutions; app development jobs may only use solutions under it (DESIGN.md 10b). dev = the key of this app's dev copy: a change to something live here that was not tried there first is flagged in the pop-up (DESIGN.md 10d). fedev is always called Donor App Dev (Dylan, 10/7/26).
